title: Automatic maintenance status on rental end date
gherkin:
Feature: Post-rent maintenance handling
  Scenario: Equipment transitions to Maintenance status upon rental end date
    Given an equipment item with a rental agreement
    And the rental end date is today
    When the rental end date is reached
    Then the equipment status should transition to 'Maintenance'
    And the equipment should not be available for rental
rationale: Verifies the core requirement that upon reaching the rental end date, the system updates rent status to 'Maintenance', blocking further rental activity.
usedContextItems: Upon reaching the rental end date, the system shall update the rent status to 'Maintenance'|Maintenance windows block rental activity and make the item appear non-rentable while the maintenance window is in effect

## 3. Rentable Item Management

## 3.1 Item Creation
## 3.1.1 The system shall allow authorized users to create rentable items.
## .1.2 The system shall require the following fields: item name, item description, and **Item ID**.
## 3.1.3 The **Item ID** must be a unique 8-character alphanumeric string.

Tom (Operations Lead)

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)
